image_note: Control values are the initialization sequence's successfully written shadow values, not PHY register readbacks. Serial flags describe initialization/USB reset/reception/error, not PHY probe ID/scratch tests. The pre-serial packed PHY status is {SessionEnd, SessionValid, LineState[1:0]}, not the raw Debug register. After a 100 us settling delay following Function Control 0x45 readback, synchronous ULPI reads capture Debug 0x15 LineState[1:0] and then Interrupt Status 0x13 SessionEnd/SessionValid before entering serial mode. These sequential snapshots alone do not identify a connection fault. Activity page 3 records DATA[2:0] transitions and values seen only after init_done, plus TX and decoded USB reset history; it does not count packets or prove physical host reset signaling.
note: CSV time labels are retained as exported; they do not establish USB bit timing. CSV contains no GAO ID; select the image layout matching the capture record. Each complete 0,1,2,3 cycle contains eight samples per page and is coherent because the observer commits its 128-bit mailbox only before page 0. There is no snapshot sequence or freshness flag: a capture need not contain a newly acknowledged snapshot, and repeated page cycles may show the same previous snapshot. Before any 60 MHz acknowledgement, payload pages are zero. The clock count is a separate 10 ms measurement; zero persists after a full stopped-clock window. This is not a complete ULPI or USB protocol trace.
